metaTitle: Aɛesskar n Qarṭaǧ — aɛesskar n yigduden, asutel n yimeqqranen
metaDesc: Tarbaɛt tamqeddest, iɛeskriyen uḍaren Ilibiyen, aɛesskar ɣef wuyis Anumidi, imcetliyen n Baliyar, ilfan akked asutel ameqqran akk deg zzman-is: aɛesskar n Qarṭaǧ.
title: Aɛesskar n Qarṭaǧ
lede: Imdebbren iqarṭaǧiyen zdat n iɛeskriyen i d-yusan seg Lɣerb n Agaraw Alemmas meṛṛa — akked usutel ameqqran akk deg zzman-is.
units.0.name: Tarbaɛt tamqeddest
units.0.text: Ɣer 2 500 n yinamuren n tifaẓt, ddan s leslaḥ ɣezzif, ɣef leḥsab n Diyudur. Imdebbren d iqarṭaǧiyen.
units.1.name: Iɛeskriyen uḍaren Ilibiyen
units.1.text: Ul n uɛesskar: iɛeskriyen uḍaren ifaẓen, ddan s rremḥ d uglaɣelɣal, ttwasɣaren tikkelt-nniḍen di Kannas s leslaḥ yettwakksen seg Iṛumaniyen.
units.2.name: Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis Anumidi
units.2.text: War tiserdunt war lexṭam, fessus ur nettwaṭṭef ara: asḥaz, tarurwit tarrurant akked tuɣalin tuɣrint. Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis yelhan akk deg Agaraw Alemmas.
units.3.name: Imcetliyen
units.3.text: Ttwasɣaren seg tmeẕẕuɣt, ddan s tlata n tɣamsa akken ad wten s tanzagin yemgaraden (Strabun), ssekcamen aẓru d tirgalin n rrṣaṣ.
units.4.name: Iberiyen, Iseltiberiyen, Igaliyen
units.4.text: Tasmi tiberit — Ṛuma teẖdem seg-s gladius hispaniensis-ines — akked tɣecwect n Igaliyen n ugafa n Italya, i ddukklen deg Italya: tlemmast n uggur n Kannas.
units.5.name: Ilfan
units.5.text: Laslaḥ n uẖellel d uẖuf; 80 di Zama ɣef leḥsab n Bulib.
shipAlt: Taɣmart n lbabuṛ apunik n Marsala
shipCap: Lbabuṛ apunik n Marsala, aqeṛn wis 3 uqbel Ɛisa
navyText: Lbabuṛen ipunikiyen ttwabnan s telqey tazuzayt: iẖricen-nsen sɛan tsekkilin n usbenneɣ, akken i t-id-yesken uẖiyar n Marsala. Ṛuma teẖdem ɣef lbabuṛ aqarṭaǧi yesɣumben akken ad tbeg asutel-ines amezwaru.
recruitParas.0: Qarṭaǧ, tamdint n ttjara ur nesɛi ara aṭas n yinamuren, ur tesger ara iɛesskaren imeqqranen n yinamuren. Tesmaɣlay tlata n yiɣbula: Ilibiyen n tmurt-is tafriqit, ilaq-asen leqdic; tirebbuɛin n yigelliden d yimeqqranen imɛawanen, ɣer tazwara Inumidiyen; akked yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen yettwasɣen s lexlaṣ di Ispanya, di Gal, di Baliyar, di Lyunan neɣ di Kampanya.
recruitParas.1: Iqayden d imdebbren llan d iqarṭaǧiyen. Inamuren qeddcen ugar deg usutel, ur ddin ara s leslaḥ s tegrawla ala m'ara d-yili uẖaṭar ameqqran — mgal Agathoklis deg 310, mgal Regulus deg 256-255, deg uhuzi aneggaru n 149-146.
recruitParas.2: Anagraw-agi yesɛa talast-is: deg 241, iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen i d-yuɣalen seg Sqilliya, ur ttwaxelsen ara mliḥ, ssukkren. Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen (241-238) qrib yewwi Qarṭaǧ, uqbel ma Hamilqar Barka i t-yehudden.
xanText: Aɛeskri uqeṛḍas aspartit yettwasɣen sɣur Qarṭaǧ asmi aqunṣul Regulus yessers lkamb-is zdat Tunes. Issebded ɛawed aɛesskar, isseqdec aɛesskar ɣef wuyis akked ilfan deg uzaɣaṛ, yehudd ilijyun: Regulus yettwaṭṭef, Qarṭaǧ tettusellek.
numbers.0.v: Ifeg seg Qarṭaǧant s 90 000 n iɛeskriyen uḍaren akked 12 000 ɣef wuyis.
numbers.1.v: Yeǧǧa tirebbuɛin n uḥadar di Ispanya: yezger idurar n Pirene s 50 000 n iɛeskriyen uḍaren akked 9 000 ɣef wuyis; 37 n ilfan zegren Ṛun.
numbers.2.v: Yewweḏ ɣer Italya seld idurar n Alpes: 12 000 n Ifriqiyen, 8 000 n Iberiyen akked 6 000 ɣef wuyis, uṭṭunen i gejreḏ Hanibal s yiman-is ɣer ẖali Lacinium.
numbers.3.v: Ɣer 40 000 n iɛeskriyen uḍaren akked 10 000 ɣef wuyis zdat ɣer 80 000 n Iṛumaniyen d yimɛawanen-nsen.
numbers.4.v: 80 n ilfan deg tɣelt tamezwarut, sakin iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen, Ilibiyen d Iqarṭaǧiyen, akked iqeddimen n Italya deg tmendawt.
shipsAside: Asutel n umennuɣ akked win n ttjara qeddcen i yiwet n lqeṣd: ṭṭfen iberdan n ttjara (Lancel).
galleyAlt: Ilkanen ifinisiyen, askan ɣef uɣerman n Ninive
galleyCap: Ilkanen d lbabuṛen ifinisiyen, ttwaxedmen ɣef uɣerman aasiri n Ninive: Qarṭaǧ tweṛt tamusni-agi n lebḥer.
ships.0.name: Tirirem
ships.0.text: Tlata n ileqqaḍ n yimeqdafen yettwasersen afella ɣef wayeḏ akked tiɣmart n uẖenneq ɣer tazwara: lbabuṛ aklasiki, ɣer 200 n yergazen deg-s, 170 seg-sen d imeqdafen.
ships.1.name: Takwadrirem
ships.1.text: Ukkuẕ n yimeqdafen deg yal aẖric n usɣenjiw, i lbabuṛ yeẕẕayen ugar, ijamden ugar. Plin, yesmekta Aristu, isers asnulfu-ines ɣef Iqarṭaǧiyen.
ships.1.src: Plin, Amezruy n tɣawsiwin n ṭṭbiɛa, VII, 207
ships.2.name: Kinkiṛim
ships.2.text: Tlul-d di Sarakuza ɣer 399 ddawt Denys Amɣar, tuɣal d lbabuṛ ameqqran n imenɣan mgal Ṛuma: ɣer 300 n yimeqdafen akked 120 n yiɛeskriyen n lebḥer, ɣef leḥsab n Bulib.
ships.3.name: Gauloi
ships.3.text: Igrikiyen ssawalen-as gaulos i lbabuṛ ajerrurdi n Ifinisiyen: tagant tehlal, tafeluct tamrabaɛt, drus n ssuken. Lbabuṛen-agi n ttjara ssexdamen daɣen lqut d tɣawsiwin i yisutal n umennuɣ.
ships.4.name: Hippoi
ships.4.text: Lkanen yesɛan taɣmart yettwajerren d aqeṛru n uyis — syen-d isem-nsen agriki, « iyisan ». Ɣef leḥsab n Strabun, iḥewwasen imecṭaḥ n Gadir sseqdacen-ten akken ad ṣeggḍen ɣef rrif n Muṛiṭanya, armi d asif n Lixus.
peripl.0.v: Seg tazwara, asutel apunik iḥares iberdan n ttjara, iḥerz lbaḏna-nsen: aḥares n tbuɣezt yebɣa-d amdal n Agaraw Aṭlanti zdat yimnafeqen igrikiyen, iFukaɛiyen ɣer tazwara.
peripl.1.v: Asutel iṛuḥ ad iḍfeṛ rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti n Tafrikt. Kra ssersen-t armi d tagna n Gine, wiyaḏ drus aṭas: tanzagt n tirzi mazal-itt d tiɣmist. Taqsiṭ tagrikit ad tili d tasuqilt n tira tapunikt yettwaskanen deg umqam (Hours-Miédan).
peripl.2.v: Ɣer ugafa, seld Gadir, ɣef webrid n lqesdir n tegzirin n Kasiteridis, ɣer tama n tegzirin tabritanit (Plin, Avyenus).
peripl.3.v: Hirudut yeqqar-d dakken imsebrayen ifinisiyen i gxeddmen i ufarɛun Nikaw wis snat ad ilin ɛeddan akk Tafrikt deg tlata iseggasen: tamusni n ttrisekt i teweṛt Qarṭaǧ (Hirudut, IV, 42).
islandText: Ɣer lebɛid seld Tigejda n Hercule, Iqarṭaǧiyen ad ilin ufan tagzirt ur nesɛi imezdaɣ, teccur d isekla, texdaɛ, izegren-tt isaffen i gezmer ad ten-zegren lbabuṛen. Aṭas i tt-isɛeddan, kra sersen iman-nsen din. S lxuf belli ad tt-tessaweḏ i yibeṛṛaniyen, ad tṛuḥ i temdint, imeqqranen gdlen abrid ɣer-s ddawt uɣelluy n tmettant, ssaḥun wid i deg zedɣen, akken yiwen ur d-yemmeslay fell-as. Taqsiṭ ur nettwabeṭṭu ara, tesmekta ɣer tazwara aẖatar n ttrisekt n imsebrayen ipunikiyen.
islandSrc: Aɣbalu: De mirabilibus auscultationibus, 84 — tabdart yettwaselsen s diri ɣer Aristu
cmd.0.v: I d-ilulen seg twacult timeqqranin, ttwafernen sɣur tejmaɛt n uɣref ɣef leḥsab n Diyudur (XXV, 8). Aẖatar aɛeskri ur yettwassen ara mliḥ; isem n unmhal ad yili d win n tpunikt rab.
cmd.1.v: Temdint ur tsemmeḥ ara i uxsaṛan: idrisen bedren aṭas n yiqayden yettwaẕẕayen ttwasemmṣen neɣ ttwanɣan (Dridi).
cmd.2.v: Seg zzman aqdim, axsaṛan n Qarṭaǧ yettwasers ɣef iɛeskriyen-is uqeṛḍasen d lexsas n ṭṭbiɛa n yinamuren-is. D anecṭaḥ ad teṭṭuḏ belli asutel n umennuɣ yettban ɣef yinamuren, akked belli aɣref meṛṛa yennuɣ deg imenɣan ineggura.
cmd.3.v: I umusnaw n umezruy Khaled Melliti, aẖric iqjin n yiɛeskriyen uḍaren yella assaɣen d Ilibiyen n daxel, syen Iberiyen n Ispanya tabarkit, ttkemmlen-t tudrin tifinisiyin n Tafrikt am Utika neɣ Hadrumet: nhaden iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen ur neqqar ara akked yisegmanen imaynuten.
arms.0.v: Iɛeskriyen uḍaren ddan s rremḥ d tsmi (Dridi).
arms.1.v: Tirebbuɛin fessusit: ijennwiyen, isekkinen d yiglaɣelɣal n weglim.
arms.2.v: Aglaɣelɣal d falcata, tasmi tawezlant yesɛan nnab yextawan.
arms.3.v: Iɛeskriyen uḍaren iẖeṣnen yettwasersen s wudem amaqduni; ur nessin ara ma tella tesɣunt tiɣezfant, sarisa, yettwaseqdac deg-s.
arms.4.v: Ahat tweṛtent-d seg lɛada talibikt taqburt.
arms.5.v: Drus-iten, ttwasɣen taẖiṛt, ahat seld umennuɣ n Pirrus di Italya. Ahat d taddart tamecṭuḥt n lfil n lɣaba n Tafrikt (tiktit n Philippe Leveau); kra n bab lfil ad ilin d Ihendiyen.
landTactics.0.title: Falanj d lkambat
landTactics.0.text: Qarṭaǧ teẖdem seg umaḏal agriki d umaqduni asekles n falanj, aserwes n uɛesskar deg tanekra akked usegmi n lkambat (Dridi).
landTactics.1.title: Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis d uẕẕi
landTactics.1.text: Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis yuɣal d leslaḥ ifran; acengu yettuẕẕa di Kannas (216); tuffra n ugelmam n Trasimen (217) tɛawan ɣef lexsas n uṭṭun.
landTactics.2.title: Taẓuri n uhuzi
landTactics.2.text: Tiɣmert n uhuzi, ilkebcan, balistat akked tqattafin: deg 409, aɛesskar n Hanibal Amagoni yeṭṭef Sélinonte s tɣemrin ɛlayen yettmussunen akked ilkebcan (Diyudur, XIII, 54).
svgLabel: Askan: deg diekplous, lbabuṛ yezger taẕrigt n ucengu sakin yuɣal yehudd-itt; deg périplous, yeẖaṣer afus-is.
sea.0.v: Ad tseɣreq lbabuṛ n ucengu s uẖenneq-is seg idis neɣ seg deffir: kullec yebna ɣef ttaẓ d usmɣer n yimeqdafen.
sea.1.v: Ikeččem deg tagra n uẕaṛaṛ n ucengu, sakin yezzi akken ad yeẖnneq lbabuṛen seg deffir.
sea.2.v: Yeẖaṣer afus n ucengu akken ad t-yeṭṭef seg idis — d wayen i gesnan azal n uẕaṛaṛ ɣezzifen ugar n win n ucengu.
sea.3.v: Akken ad tensi tamusni tapunikt, Ṛuma tesnulfa « aɣerbib », aɣaraf n uẖdaɛ i gbeddlen amennuɣ n lebḥer ɣer umennuɣ n yiɛeskriyen uḍaren: lfer amezwaru n Ṛuma deg lebḥer.
sea.4.v: Anmhal n lebḥer Adherbal, s lbabuṛen irurad ugar d yiẖricen ifaẓen, yeẕẕi asutel aṛumi ɣer webrid n lebḥer, yeṭṭef 93 n lbabuṛen: lfer ameqqran n Qarṭaǧ deg lebḥer deg umennuɣ-agi (Bulib, I, 49-51).
heritage.0.title: Yal aɣref deg wemkan-is
heritage.0.text: Iɛeskriyen Inumidiyen ɣef wuyis i ṭṭhur, imcetliyen n Baliyar i uẖellel, Ilibiyen d Iberiyen i tɣelt: Hanibal yerra asemyed-agi d laslaḥ n tirrategt.
heritage.1.title: Lemtel n uẕẕi
heritage.1.text: Aẕẕi n snat n tɣelfin n 216 yettwaẓar deg tesdawiyin n uɛesskar armi d zzman-agi; Schlieffen yerra-t d ul n tsertit-ines.
heritage.2.title: Sḏis mraw iseggasen war tuccḍa
heritage.2.text: Ɣef leḥsab n Bulib, aɛesskar n Hanibal n waṭas n yigduden werǧin iskker deg sḏis mraw iseggasen n umennuɣ di Italya, ɣas akken tezger-it ṣṣɛuba.
